name: Dhin
source:
The cheeky and mischievous third youngest brother - Dhin plays as a clown on stage, and a writer off stage. A lover of horror, he enjoys playing pranks on his siblings, especially his nemesis, Land.
Food: Banana Milk
Interest: Horror, Art & Puzzles

Trigger: ???
Gets Along: Cat & Sheep
Doesn't Get Along: Snail
